about.heading: A seasoned editor with a wide creative range.

paragraphs.text: Double Dag Productions is my creative home. My work spans documentary, music, history, science, travel, culinary, educational programming, branded storytelling, social media, and feature film.
My approach combines strong editorial instincts, technical polish, and a deep respect for story, performance, pacing, and emotional clarity.
